items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: He worked with all of us, too.

ctx.x: And R.D. played trumpet with you.

Well, he came in, true enough, but what I mean, he's just talking about when he started off. Oh, he started off. Oh, he started off. Alphonse was with him when we first started off. Who was Alphonse? Alphonse Gambler. He's a trumpet player. He worked with all of us, too. Alphonse Gambler? Gambler. Gambler. G.M.B.L.E. Gambler. He's a fine trumpet player, but he doesn't play anymore. He had always teeth pulled, so he doesn't play anymore. That was Diddy Buddy. He works at the post-op. He's something at the post-op…
Well, tell me, when you were starting out, the bands down here, did they play like Buddy Fatigue and on that R-R? Would they play strictly reading or what?
